hypotheses.reasoning: Migration 0050_add_region_id renamed accounts.region_id to region_id_old (step 1, #204), then step 2 failed on a lock timeout (#210). Because the DDL wasn't transactional, the rename stayed in place and was never rolled back. From #219 on, every account-svc query on region_id fails with 'column does not exist' (#229, #234, #254). account-svc returns 500, and edge-proxy passes that on as 500 on POST /login. Logins were still succeeding just before the migration (#206, #209, #213). The audit-consumer deploy (#184) and the TLS cert warning (#51) have nothing to do with the login path.
The migration might have shipped with an account-svc release. Even so, the fault itself is a half-applied schema change, so data_integrity fits better.

verdict.recommendedAction: Rename accounts.region_id_old back to region_id (or finish the migration) right away to restore logins. Hold migration 0050 until it is rewritten to be transactional or idempotent, and run it in a low-traffic window with a suitable lock_timeout.
